dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Detect suspicious net.exe spawning net1.exe
id: 854a389f-fc0a-4ff5-ba36-650e12c3e17b
status: experimental
description: Detects a suspicious process creation where net.exe spawns net1.exe,
  which is a known technique for command and control.
references: https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \net1.exe
    ParentImage|endswith: \net.exe
    CommandLine|contains: time \localhost
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative tasks
level: medium
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:

    <field name="win.eventdata.image" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+net1\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+net\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.commandLine" type="pcre2">(?i)time\ \\+localhost</field>
    <description>Detect suspicious net.exe spawning net1.exe [Alert: AI-20261012_133641.997-970f35762bea]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1087</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
